title: Held-Karp dynamic programming
assumptions: General weighted graph or complete graph
conclusion: Exact but not polynomial-time in the general case.

title: Karp reductions and NP-completeness
conclusion: Provides the theoretical basis for understanding the hardness of general TSP.

title: Christofides approximation
conclusion: Strong approximation guarantee, but not exact for the general case.

title: Arora PTAS for Euclidean TSP
conclusion: Efficient approximation exists in a special geometric setting, not in the general TSP.
